coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED (WebSearch quota for this session was already exhausted, so everything below came from direct HTTP fetches of known URLs plus the Wayback CDX API):
1. Wikipedia, 2013 Florida State Seminoles football team — coaching staff box (11 on-field entries) plus a bare-name "Support Staff" list.
2. Archived seminoles.com 2013 Florida State Football Roster page, "Coaches" anchor section, Wayback snapshot 20131017120601 — the single best structured source: 15 name-plus-title pairs covering all on-field coaches, the head S&C coach, director of football operations, director of player personnel, and both listed graduate assistants.
3. Archived seminoles.com athletics staff directory (school-bio/fsu-contacts.html), Wayback snapshots 20131017115151 (in-season) and 20140215155124 (five weeks after the BCS title game) — Football section broken into SECRETARIES / ADMINISTRATION / HEAD COACHES OFFICE / OFFENSE / DEFENSE / RECRUITING, plus Equipment, Coaches Video and Weight Rooms sections.
4. The 2013 FSU football media guide ("prospectus.pdf", 212 pp.) linked from the archived roster page — "Florida State Football Staff" table (p. 7), coach bios (pp. 58-72), "2013 Graduate Assistants" panel (p. 73), "SUPPORT STAFF" page (p. 74), football strength and conditioning and nutrition panels (p. 118), and athletic training / team physicians / specialists panels (pp. 120-121).

QUOTE MECHANICS / CAVEATS:
- Media-guide rows carry quote "" as instructed, because the PDF's decorative section headings inject long runs of repeated letters into the text layer and cell text is emitted as separate lines, so no faithful contiguous quote exists. The exact panel and printed page number is given in each note.
- Quotes taken from the archived staff directory are HTML table rows where the name and the title sit in adjacent <td> cells. The quoted string is the whitespace-normalized visible text ("Name Title"); it will match an extraction that inserts a separator between cells, but not one that renders the table as pipe-delimited markdown. Quotes from the archived roster page ("Name - Role") are contiguous in the underlying markup and should match either way.
- WebFetch is blocked from web.archive.org in this environment, so archived pages were retrieved with curl; the Wayback URLs given are the ones that returned HTTP 200.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT:
- No snapshot of the seminoles.com roster/coaches page exists between Oct. 17, 2013 and Aug. 2014, so nothing confirms the staff list as of the Jan. 6, 2014 title game itself. The Feb. 15, 2014 staff directory snapshot still shows the full 2013 on-field staff (including Jeremy Pruitt, who left for Georgia in Jan. 2014), which is consistent with everyone listed here having been present for the championship game. Only Kali Hunter changes between the two directory snapshots and is flagged with a midseason_note.
- Wikipedia's "Support Staff" list contains eight names I could not corroborate anywhere in the 2013 media guide or either archived staff directory: Jeremiah Wilson, Brian Williams, Jamie Mujeni, Chris Revell, Matt McCutchan, Roy Upchurch, Ernest Bradley and Paul Sheffield. Several of these appear to have been FSU staffers in later seasons, so the Wikipedia list may be conflating years. I included them because Wikipedia is a real cited source, but each row's note flags the weak documentation — treat them as unverified for 2013.
- Name-spelling conflict left unresolved: the media guide prints "Steve Schlemon" while both staff-directory snapshots print "Steve Shelmon". I used the media guide spelling for the name field and the directory spelling inside the quote.
- I deliberately excluded athletics-department-wide staff who appear on the media guide's support-staff page but are not football-specific (communications, marketing, facilities, ticket office, business office, human resources, Seminole Productions), as well as the media relations football contacts (Kerwin Lonzo, Zach Stipe). They are documented at the same URLs if the dataset wants a wider boundary.
- Olympic-sport strength coaches listed in the directory's Weight Rooms section (Jon Jost, Joseph Danos, Adam Ross, Brian Johnson, Caitlin Quinn, Mike Bradley, Dave Plettl) were excluded; the media guide's "FOOTBALL STRENGTH & CONDITIONING STAFF" panel names only Viloria plus Derek Smith, Louis Dobosenski, Brice Lockart and Brandon Sanders.
- Only three graduate assistants are documented (Spurlock, Lynch, Helow); no fourth GA appears in any source. Student assistants, managers, and video/recruiting interns beyond those named above are not enumerated anywhere I could reach.
